config.errors.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# Konfigurationsfehler gefunden.} other {# Konfigurationsfehler gefunden.}}
config.errors.description: Summary printed before the list of configuration problems when the server refuses to start.

config.invalid.defaultMessage: Die Einstellung {name} hat einen ungültigen Wert.
config.invalid.description: A configuration value failed validation at startup. {name} is the environment variable or config file key, e.g. MY_DATABASE.

config.missing.defaultMessage: Die erforderliche Einstellung {name} ist nicht gesetzt.
config.missing.description: A required configuration value is absent at startup. {name} is the environment variable or config file key, e.g. MY_DATABASE_URL.

config.readiness.errors.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# Einstellung gefunden, die nicht produktionsreif ist.} other {# Einstellungen gefunden, die nicht produktionsreif sind.}}
config.readiness.errors.description: Summary printed by `my config check` before the list of settings that are valid but break or weaken a production instance, such as a key-encryption key that is not random. The command fails on them.

config.readiness.warnings.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# Warnung zum Betrieb in der Produktion gefunden.} other {# Warnungen zum Betrieb in der Produktion gefunden.}}
config.readiness.warnings.description: Summary printed by `my config check` before the list of settings and instance settings that are usual in development and may be deliberate in production, such as mail = none. The command still succeeds.
